name: ai_ops_dashboard
description: Track API usage and costs across multiple AI platforms in one beautiful dashboard
features: Platform cards for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, Midjourney, ElevenLabs with logo icons (SVG initials or emoji icons)
Animated usage bar per platform showing current usage vs monthly budget/limit — fills left to right
Toggle between subscription mode (manual usage entry) and API token mode (shows per-token cost calculation)
Total monthly spend summary card across all platforms with big number display
Monthly spend history bar chart for last 6 months built with Canvas API
Alert system — usage bar turns red and card glows red at 80% of budget
Projected end-of-month spend card based on current usage pace and days remaining
Add/edit/delete platforms and their budgets
'Your Brand Here' logo placeholder (40x40 rounded square, top-left) and editable custom title field
All data persists in localStorage — no data loss on refresh

name: sports_bankroll_manager
description: Professional bankroll management for sports bettors — track every bet, analyze performance, and manage risk
features: Current bankroll display with unit size calculator (1 unit = configurable % of bankroll)
Per-sport P&L tracking with visual bar chart breakdown (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, Soccer, etc.)
Per-sportsbook P&L tracking (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars, etc.)
Parlay vs straight bet performance comparison — separate ROI for each
Streak tracker showing current winning/losing streak with longest streak record
ROI % by bet type, sport, and rolling time period (7d/30d/all-time)
Kelly Criterion calculator — input win probability and odds, outputs optimal stake
Win rate display with 95% confidence interval shown as a range
Monthly/weekly/daily P&L toggle views
Bet log table with add/edit/delete — columns: date, sport, game, pick, odds, stake, result, P&L
Bankroll growth line chart over time built with Canvas API
'Your Brand Here' branding zone in header with editable title

name: dca_portfolio_tracker
description: Track your dollar-cost averaging strategy across stocks, crypto, and other investments
features: Three tabbed sections: Stocks, Crypto, Other Investments — each independently managed
Per-asset row: ticker symbol, shares/units held, average cost basis, current price (manually updated), total value, return $ and return %
DCA schedule tracker per asset — contribution amount, frequency (weekly/bi-weekly/monthly), next buy date
Portfolio allocation donut chart showing % breakdown by asset, built with Canvas API
Total portfolio value card with $ change and % change from total cost basis
Net worth summary bar across all three sections
Price update instructions placeholder — text explaining how to use Yahoo Finance API or similar
Portfolio value over time line chart (manual entry of historical snapshots) built with Canvas API
Add/edit/delete holdings with full modal form
'Your Brand Here' branding in header with editable title
All holdings and history persist in localStorage
